chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Yunus, from Abdullah ibn Sinan who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The one whom the people fear his tongue, so he would be in the Fire'.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of a person whose speech causes fear in others?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies the fear of one's evil tongue as a definitive sign of impending Hellfire, emphasizing that verbal harm is a critical spiritual defect. This hadith underscores the Shia ethical principle that the tongue is a primary instrument of either salvation or damnation, linking social anxiety caused by an individual directly to their eschatological fate.

en.hubeali: From him, from Muhammad Bin Isa Bin Ubeyd, from Yunus, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one whom the people fear his tongue, so he would be in the Fire’.
en.sarwar: 3. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ‘Ubayd from Yunus from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘Whoever is feared because of his foul language will be in the fire.’”
